task: Creative track: new Hearth & Horizon story from the BIBLE.md proposal 'The beans that took till dark' (solar cookers in the Harmattan)

errors.what: my first cooker model had the daily air-temperature curve inverted (coldest at 15:00) and a wind term so strong the label fell from 60 W to 11 W; both caught by reading the hourly trace before drafting and fixed

doc_friction.issue: The proposal said the beans should be cowpeas-like 'beans' cooked in solar boxes; once the food-safety rule (a hard boil) and the 10-30 min agency boil times were worked in, soaked cowpeas are nearly cooked by the boil itself, so retained heat saves little. Bambara groundnuts (a 4-hour legume) made the physics honest. Proposals that hinge on a cooking time should name the food and its time from a source.
Says to search open PRs with search_pull_requests; that MCP tool is not exposed in this session. gh api search/issues (as BIBLE.md says) worked.

deviations.why: Proposal named beans generically and a fix of boxes then baskets with charcoal only as backup; the food-safety check showed beans must boil hard first, which the boxes cannot do in haze
deviations.did: Used Bambara groundnuts (voandzou) and made the oldest cook's charcoal fire do a mandatory quarter-hour hard boil; boxes and baskets do the long cooking
deviations.result: Model gives fire about 1 h instead of nearly 5, and neither box nor basket alone suffices, which became the story's turn

deviations.did: Text only, no audio and no podcast episode
deviations.result: Story, pages, feeds and post landed without audio

notes: Project: hearth-and-horizon; piece: the-beans-that-took-till-dark (about 4,800 words of story plus a closing note with the full model). Security queue empty; IDEAS.md and website requests empty; route drew creative/0. Claimed the proposal with a Drafting commit and draft PR #17813 before drafting. Model (Python, scratchpad): Ouagadougou sun position, beam/diffuse split with dust optical depth 1.3, box 0.55 m2 eta0 0.40 U 3.4 W/m2K (+8%/m/s wind), label 60.5 W at S580.1 conditions; pot 12.3 kJ/K; bean softening clock with Q10 2.5. Every number in the story text and note was re-checked against the model output; weekdays checked (2 Dec 2051 Sat, 16 Dec Sat, 24 Dec Sun, 25 Dec Mon, 18 Nov third Saturday). Sources: ASAE S580.1 (2013) via secondary descriptions (full text not read; note says only what the secondary sources state); Clauzel et al. ACP 25, 997-1021, 2025; Health Canada lectins page; FDA 30-min figure via secondary sources. Verification: node --test in ventures/hearth-and-horizon 20/20 pass; check_posts ok. A new proposal (hermetic grain bags) and three subject candidates added to keep the shelf's list non-empty.
